title: An AI tool for building NSGo apps, such as an agent skill or an MCP server, one file per tool named after its slug

url.description: Where the tool is: its repository, or its folder in a repository that holds several, such as one skill of a collection.

type.description: What it is: skill for an agent skill (SKILL.md), mcp for an MCP server or library, rules for instructions for coding agents (AGENTS.md, Cursor rules), other for anything else.

install.description: The command that installs it, e.g. npx skills add owner/name or go get …

provisional.description: The images that stand in until the project gives its own: GitHub's card of the repository or a card drawn of it for a screenshot. The completing script sets it; the announcement's issue asks the project for them; whoever replaces one drops it from the list.
